title: The Angular Seed Power Map: A Constructive Approach to Recursive Scaling Spirals
summary: We present the ''Power Spiral Map'', a continuous angular evolution of the linear coordinate grid established in our previous work. While that previous Power Map utilized a seed value translating along a horizontal axis, this work builds upon a seed angle ($θ$) projected onto a unit diameter circle.
